title: Derived-unit evaluation of the supported source
statement:
theorem supported_source_arrow_derived
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ X)
    (d : Diagram Λ Y L) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).map d.support₂.iso.hom ≫
        diagonalTraceRightSingle
          (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ (secondProjection Y)) d.R₂
          (source Λ Y) ≫
        (secondDiagramPushIso Λ Y L d).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
            (source Λ Y)) =
      (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≫
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).map
          (supportedUnitIso Λ Y).hom

proof.text: Precompose the residual derived compatibility with the degree-zero image of the support isomorphism. The residual compatibility is the strictly simpler core theorem supported_source_arrow_derived_core. Functoriality combines the two maps, and the inverse/hom isomorphism identity cancels the support normalization.
